attchmntText: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited has published extracts of its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisement appeared in the Free Press Gujarat and Lokmitra newspapers on November 07, 2026. The company states that copies of the publications are attached and available on its website at www.nityas.in. This filing is made pursuant to Regulation 4, 7, and 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The document also contains unrelated news reports regarding increased bus fares in Gujarat and a new curriculum for the 2027 academic year.

attchmntText: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
